rater.name: Claude (Anthropic)
rater.c1: Not met: the plans were written after the AI rater had read the case evidence.
rater.use: Separate AI rater for comparison with the two human assessors, opened only after both have finished. Not a human rating; not study data for kappa between humans.

case: Rite Aid facial recognition (R0, outside evidence)
evidenceBase: Reuters special report, 28 Jul 2020, as reported by Gizmodo (28 Jul 2020): 200 stores over eight years, two vendors (FaceFirst, then DeepCam from 2018); Reuters visited 75 stores in Manhattan and central Los Angeles - journalism; observations of stores are treated as observable (O), quotes from staff as anecdote
Excluded: FTC complaint and stipulated order (2023), the reference for comparison layer B (Section 6.2)
Cut-off set by the AI rater: 31 Jul 2020, after the Reuters report and before the FTC action
